Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-28T14:01Z

PR #27244 merged at `385aa129`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On 18 of the 19 paths the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `c483a00e` byte for byte. On `protocol.mdx`, the PR's net hunks are identical between the merge-base and the merge, and the bytes differ only because other work landed on `main` in between.

`QuerySchema.fields` (and so every `expand` entry) and the flow `get_record` node's `fields` now refuse an empty projection with "Name at least one field". A REST POST body with `fields: []` is refused at the body schema, `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.fields`, the same as `$select`. There is no D2 conversion. A stored flow carrying `fields: []` is refused at `registerFlow` until its row is edited. ADR-0087 D3 is `query-and-get-record-empty-projection-refused`.

The card closed through `Fixes #27166`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.
